verdict.rationale: Lever's high-volume hiring docs say its Automation Hub handles archiving, tagging, emailing and advancing candidates, and its nurture feature automates outreach at scale. That suggests actions applied across many candidates, but it reads as rule-driven automation rather than an explicit bulk-action capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of selecting many items and acting on them at once, bulk API endpoints, documented limits or scope of bulk actions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Lever's Automation Hub handles routine tasks like archiving, tagging, emailing, and advancing candidates.
